units.source_text: 用的是绿色带纹样的信纸，与这日子相符合。

en.t: The stationery used was green and patterned, fitting for the occasion.

units.source_text: 墨色或浓或淡，交互错综。

en.t: The ink varied from dark to pale, interweaving in complex patterns.

units.source_text: 字体大都是草书，笔法随意不拘。

en.t: Most of the writing was in cursive script, with a free and unrestrained brush style.

units.source_text: 源氏觉得此信与筑紫五节舞姬的人品相称，颇感兴味。

en.t: Genji felt that the letter suited the character of the Gosechi dancer from Tsukushi, and he found it quite intriguing.
